fix_instructions: To ensure the hidden information is necessary, modify the content checks so that they do not default to 'false' or 'caution' when information is missing. Specifically, tighten C2, C5, and P1 (dependent on PF1) and C3, C4, and C6 (dependent on PF2) by requiring them to only pass if the exact values (e.g., 6000000 USD, 10% margin, 180 days) are explicitly confirmed, rather than allowing a generic 'compliance review' to satisfy the logic of the scenario.
